Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the relevant “Confessions” album by assuming it referred to Louise’s 2025 album and directed the search toward Louise’s lead single “Confession.” This disambiguation failure ignored the far more prominent and historically relevant 2004 Usher album “Confessions,” whose lead single “Yeah!” famously dominated the charts and kept other popular songs stuck behind it for weeks. This incorrect initial focus led subsequent steps down an irrelevant path, delaying convergence on the correct answer (Usher).
